name: timebase

scripts.update: npm update web-futures --save && npm run update:meta
scripts.update:meta: node extract-data.js && node extract-bcd-data.js && node developer-signals.js && node interop.js && node mdn-docs.js
scripts.stop: kill $(lsof -t -i:8080) || echo 'No server running on port 8080'
scripts.stop:bcd: kill $(lsof -t -i:8081) || echo 'No server running on port 8081'
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:bcd
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.dev:bcd: npm run build:bcd && npm run start:bcd
scripts.dev:all: npm run build:all && npm run start & npm run start:bcd

description: Timeline of web features and browser support
